architecture: client-server with Socket.IO real-time communication. React SPA frontend (Vite), Express+Socket.IO backend. Games use flat array boards with move validation on both client (local play) and server (online play).

code_style.naming: camelCase for functions/variables, PascalCase for components. Game IDs are lowercase strings (e.g. 'tictactoe', 'connect4'). Board components named {Game}Board.jsx.
code_style.imports: Named imports from relative paths. React components use default exports. Game logic modules export named functions (make{Game}Move, check{Game}Winner, getInitial{Game}Board).
code_style.error_handling: Socket callbacks with { error } or { success } patterns. No try-catch blocks in game logic — invalid moves return { valid: false }.
code_style.file_organization: By layer: components/, pages/, context/, utils/ on client. utils/ on server. Each game has: server logic (server/utils/), client logic (client/src/utils/), board component (client/src/components/), board CSS.

conventions: Each game needs: server logic file, client logic file (for local play), Board component + CSS, registration in Games.jsx GAMES array, rendering branch in Game.jsx, server.js move/init/restart/rematch handlers
Board state is a flat array (e.g. Array(9) for 3x3, Array(64) for 8x8). null = empty.
Move functions return { valid: boolean, board, result, nextTurn }. result is { winner, line } or null.
Games use X/O for standard 2-player roles, b/r for checkers-style games.
Server handles: createRoom board init, makeMove validation, restartGame reset, rematch reset.
Sidebar.jsx has gameRouteMap and gameNameMap that must be updated for new games.
Game.jsx handleCellClick handles local move logic per game type. Online moves emit 'makeMove' socket event.
Timer uses 30-second turns. Timer logic in server for online, useEffect interval for local.
Commit messages follow: feat(scope): description pattern
